body: Forward test of the base rate method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.60 (naive base rate 0.65) that: HDFC AMC Q3 FY27 revenue from operations is ≥₹1,200 cr. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (15-Oct-2026): revenue from operations ₹11.7 bn (+14% YoY), operating profit ₹9.1 bn (36 bps of AUM); QAAUM ₹9.69 tn (+10% YoY, +4% QoQ); equity 67.1% of AUM; active-equity yield 61 bps, debt 28–29, liquid 13. Industry: 67th straight month of equity inflows; Nifty fell ~5% in the Sep quarter. Screener revenue (₹ cr): Q3 FY26 1,074, Q4 1,050, Q1 FY27 1,098, Q2 FY27 1,169. Nifty 20-Nov-2026: 25,800.6 (52-wk high 26,373). Reasoning: Base-rate call: AMC revenue mostly follows average equity AUM, which rises with flows unless markets fall. Needs only +2.7% QoQ. We shade a little below base because yields drift down as AUM grows (TER slabs) and the Nifty has been range-bound since September. Resolution: YES if HDFC AMC's revenue from operations (consolidated; standalone if only that is given) for the quarter ended 31-Dec-2026 is ≥₹1,200 cr (₹12.0 bn). Source: HDFC AMC Q3 FY27 results (NSE) / screener.in quarterly table. Resolve by 2027-02-15; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: HDFC AMC revenue grew ≥2.7% QoQ in 4 of the last 5 quarters; long-run share of quarters with QoQ revenue growth for Indian listed AMCs ~70%. Base ~65%.
